svg.text: Factory: machines on the storage cable
a small wired modem on each
feeder: hopper on top, pointing down
security Public, wired modem on it
infusion feeder on a side, output chest under
• Every machine, feeder and output chest gets a wired modem joined to the storage cable: right-click each so it turns red.
• Add Mekanism machines and Create lines on the setup screen (factory setup / F1); furnaces and botany pots are found by
• Cooking pots: see Example layouts (feed hopper into the side, output hopper under, comparator and redstone relay).
